watchFor: 3D 堆疊的熱點不一定靠近散熱面。
以分層熱阻模型對照埋藏接面溫度。
標記畫面中未展示、仍需額外量測的界面。
watchForEn: A 3D-stack hotspot need not lie next to its cooling surface.
Compare a layered thermal-resistance model with buried-junction temperature.
Identify interfaces not shown that still require measurement.
videos.before: 先寫下本課的圖像判讀問題：3D 堆疊的熱點不一定靠近散熱面。
videos.beforeEn: Write the visual-reading question for this course: A 3D-stack hotspot need not lie next to its cooling surface.
videos.after: 完成觀察工作單，列出影片未能證明的三件事，並為每一件指定量測或來源。
videos.afterEn: Complete the worksheet. List three claims not established by the video and specify a measurement or source for each.

watchFor: TSV 形成、填孔及晶粒堆疊是不同責任的工序。
凸塊均勻性與電鍍空洞需要各自的量測證據。
影片展示設備能力方向；沒有給出可投產的完整製程窗口。
watchForEn: TSV formation, via filling and die stacking are separate process responsibilities.
Bump uniformity and plating voids need different measurement evidence.
The video introduces equipment capabilities, not a complete qualified production window.
videos.scope: 本課「3D 邏輯堆疊熱管理」的延伸背景。先進封裝設備與材料處理的共同背景；並非 TSMC、Intel 或每一特殊封裝的製程紀錄。 影片並非本課每一道步驟的實拍。
videos.scopeEn: Related background for Thermal management for 3D logic stacks. Shared equipment and materials-processing context for advanced packaging, not a process record for TSMC, Intel or every package type. It is not footage of every step in this course.
videos.titleEn: Inside the Chip: How Lam Research Solves Advanced Packaging Challenges for the AI Era
videos.originalTitle: Inside the Chip: How Lam Research Solves Advanced Packaging Challenges for the AI Era
videos.author: Lam Research
videos.captionNote: 字幕與翻譯由原平台提供；下列中英重點由本學院依官方介紹另行撰寫，不是逐字稿或時間軸。
videos.captionNoteEn: Captions and translations depend on the source platform. The bilingual points are original academy guides based on official descriptions, not a transcript or timestamped account.
videos.before: 先問：「標出每層熱源」需要哪種材料或介面證據？畫出本課與影片案例的共同處及不同處。
videos.beforeEn: Ask what material or interface evidence Map layer heat sources requires. Draw the common ground and differences between this course and the video case.
videos.after: 把「比較單面與雙面冷卻」列為查證任務：觀察焦點：用雙分支熱路重解層溫。 只有在控制條件一致且差異大於量測不確定度時，才把差異歸於所討論的機制。
videos.afterEn: Follow-up evidence task for Compare single and double cooling: Observation focus: Resolve layer temperatures with dual branches. Attribute differences to the mechanism only with matched controls and differences distinguishable from measurement uncertainty.

courses.summary: 本課以3D 邏輯堆疊熱阻、熱點重疊及工作負載連結材料、模型與驗證。地圖採 imec 公開研究園區作為跨領域整合的代表點；製造、量測及可靠度資料則分別引用材料廠、工具商與研究機構。這個位置提供研究脈絡，不把全球供應鏈誤縮成一處工廠。
courses.summaryEn: This course connects materials, models and validation through 3d logic thermal resistance, hotspot overlap and workloads. Imec’s public campus is a reference for interdisciplinary integration; manufacturing, metrology and reliability sources also come from vendors and research institutions. The map provides research context rather than reducing the global supply chain to one factory.

history.textEn: Imec’s official history records its establishment; collaborative research connects materials, devices and systems in one research environment.

history.title: 微流體散熱連結晶片與系統
history.titleEn: Microfluidic cooling connects chips and systems
history.text: imec 公開介紹矽微流道研究，說明晶片性能需與散熱及封裝一起思考；此為研究展示，不是所有課程的量產規格。
history.textEn: Imec publicly described silicon microchannel research, illustrating the need to consider chip performance together with cooling and packaging. This is a research demonstration, not a production specification for every course.

courses.connectionEn: Use the map as a research reference, then trace each source’s role in materials, equipment, metrology and system validation.
